# Titan Logistics

> Hardware Catalog & Global SKU Telemetry platform.

## Overview
Titan Logistics is an enterprise stock governance and telemetry platform engineered with Nuxt 4 (SSR Nitro) and NestJS (Mongoose/MongoDB). It delivers real-time SKU tracking, catalog valuation, warehouse bin management, and equipment health metrics.

## Core Capabilities
- **SKU Catalog & Inventory**: Real-time product search, filtering, and categorization across hardware appliances and SaaS software licenses.
- **Stock Valuation Matrix**: Automated real-time valuation calculated by quantity, unit cost, and warehouse node allocation.
- **Warehouse Node Telemetry**: Monitoring storage bins, stock threshold alerts, and reorder levels.
- **OpenAPI Architecture**: Standardized RESTful endpoints documented via Swagger / OpenAPI at `/api-docs`.

## Key URLs
- Homepage / Dashboard: https://inventory.titantelemetry.io/
- Products Catalog: https://inventory.titantelemetry.io/products
- System Preferences: https://inventory.titantelemetry.io/settings
- OpenAPI Explorer: https://inventory.titantelemetry.io/api-docs

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Nuxt 4.6, Vue 3.5, Tailwind CSS, Pinia
- Backend: NestJS 11, MongoDB 8, TypeScript
- Data Models: Product documents with SKU, pricing, stock levels, and category tags
